# SKRYON coding instructions

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before making changes. In every fix, trace the full feature flow and preserve all existing UX contracts, including adjacent features. Inspect call sites, background jobs, races and state transitions. For Android VPN startup, do not gate first-tap connect on optional speed probes; retain a non-blocking warning, and do not display Connected before verified tunnel traffic. Cover both the fixed behavior and neighboring behaviors with regression tests. Run Android build and JVM tests, plus backend tests where interfaces change. Review the diff for unintentionally removed features. Keep changes in draft PRs and do not merge/deploy on red or missing CI. Never modify live services, secrets, payments or domain routes as a speculative fix. Report limitations, baseline failures and device-testing status explicitly.
